scope: Profile the campaign encode path with prepare-ahead enabled. This run does not qualify serving, numerical results, or performance.

run.command: git diff --exit-code HEAD~ HEAD -- prismaquant pyproject.toml uv.lock && git rev-parse HEAD~ && export PRISMAQUANT_RELEASE_SOURCE_PAGES=1 MIMALLOC_PURGE_DELAY=0 PYTHONPATH=. PRISMAQUANT_TESSERA_PREPARE_AHEAD=1 && d=$(mktemp -d) && if python tests/test_tessera_encode_profile.py "$d" "$TL3B_OUT" >"$TL3B_OUT/2955-encode-after.log" 2>&1; then tail -n 16 "$TL3B_OUT/2955-encode-after.log" && cat "$TL3B_OUT/2955-encode-summary.json"; else tail -n 45 "$TL3B_OUT/2955-encode-after.log"; exit 1; fi
run.result: The campaign priced three units and three rungs in one format. The profiler recorded CPU and CUDA events. The input digest matches the baseline.
